resources.string: Emergency — I think I was scammed
RakshakAI doesn\'t just flag risky messages — it explains what the sender wants next, highlights pressure tactics, and gives you calm steps before harm happens.
RakshakAI does not even declare the Android INTERNET permission. Nothing leaves your phone — your messages, screenshots, and vault stay offline.
RakshakAI supports English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Hinglish messages out of the box.
You can share text/images directly from WhatsApp or SMS to RakshakAI anytime. Notifications and SMS auto-scan are completely optional.
Processed on this device · Zero internet access

What could happen if you follow it
A risk score is not proof of fraud. Predictions are possibilities, not certainties.

• Cannot read WhatsApp directly (use Share or Paste).
• Cannot delete SMS or WhatsApp messages in other apps (Quarantine keeps an encrypted copy inside RakshakAI only).
• Cannot block or lock payments in banking/UPI apps (Pre-Action Check provides a pause-and-verify reminder).
• Live Call Shield uses pasted transcripts or scripted demos — RakshakAI does not record or listen to real phone calls.
• Family Guardian alerts open your own SMS/Share sheet; the second-device Guardian Dashboard is a simulation.
• Rule-based detection can miss novel scams or raise false alarms — scores are guidance, not proof.
